title: Ordinary direct-image and internal-Hom evaluation scalar square
statement:
Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $f:Y\to X$ a morphism of schemes. Work with constant ring sheaves on small etale sites, small in the module universe, and ordinary uncompleted unbounded derived module categories. Write $F_W=-\otimes_A^LB$ for $W=X,Y$, $H_R=R\mathcal Hom_R$ for $R=A,B$, and $\alpha_{R,P}:f_R^*Rf_{*,R}P\to P$ for the ordinary counit. Use the canonical scalar tensor and pullback identifications. Let $L,N\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, let $N'\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},B)$, and let $b:F_YN\to N'$ be any morphism, not necessarily invertible. Put $Q=H_A(L,N)$ and $T=Rf_{*,A}Q$.

Define $u:F_YQ\to H_B(F_YL,F_YN)$ as the tensor--Hom transpose of $F_Y(\mathrm{ev}_A)$ under $F_Y(Q\otimes_A^LL)\cong F_YQ\otimes_B^LF_YL$. Define $c_{f,Q}:F_XT\to Rf_{*,B}F_YQ$ to be the $f_B^*\dashv Rf_{*,B}$ adjunct of $F_Y(\alpha_{A,Q})$ under $f_B^*F_X\cong F_Yf_A^*$. Put
$$w=H_B(1,b)\circ u,\qquad h=Rf_{*,B}(w)\circ c_{f,Q}:F_XT\longrightarrow Rf_{*,B}H_B(F_YL,N'),$$
$$e_A=\mathrm{ev}_A\circ(\alpha_{A,Q}\otimes1):f_A^*T\otimes_A^LL\longrightarrow N,$$
and let $\iota:F_Y(f_A^*T\otimes_A^LL)\xrightarrow{\sim}f_B^*F_XT\otimes_B^LF_YL$ be the canonical comparison. The composite ordinary inverse-image and tensor--Hom transpose of $h$ is
$$p_h=\mathrm{ev}_{B,F_YL,N'}\circ\bigl((\alpha_{B,H_B(F_YL,N')}\circ f_B^*h)\otimes1\bigr).$$
Then the following specified equality holds in $D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},B)$:
$$p_h=b\circ F_Y(e_A)\circ\iota^{-1}:f_B^*F_XT\otimes_B^LF_YL\longrightarrow N'.$$
No flatness, finiteness of coefficients, properness of $f$, boundedness, constructibility, exceptional pullback, or invertibility of $u,c_{f,Q},b$ is assumed.

proof.text: Keep the published ordinary etale definitions of evaluation, homComparison, scalarMate and sourceComparison. Their explicit definitions already specify the scalar tensor and scalar/pullback comparisons; no general ringed-site comparison theorem is needed again.

Apply Mathlib mateEquiv_counit to the two ordinary geometric adjunctions and scalarPullbackIso. Naturality of the B-geometric counit at homMap then identifies the inverse adjunct of directImageMap with scalarPullbackIso.hom followed by scalar extension of the A-geometric counit and homMap.

For any curried tensor bifunctor with a natural swap, move the tensor of the Hom comparison past that swap by naturality. Tensor-Hom homEquiv_naturality_right and homEquiv_counit cancel the defining transpose, including arbitrary postcomposition b. The two remaining opposite swaps cancel by the canonical signed-symmetry involutivity theorem. Specialize this proved private categorical calculation to obtain homMap_evaluation.

Use the first naturality clause of IsEtaleHomTensorCanonical, supplied by etaleHomTensorComparison_existsUnique, at the A-geometric counit and L. This moves scalar extension of the counit through the tensor comparison.

Expand transposedPairing, apply the two transpose equations and tensor-comparison naturality, then expand sourceComparison and ordinaryPairing. Functoriality, the explicit inverse of the composite comparison and associativity give the required equality.
